  CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that pursuant to Government Code Section 54956, by delivery of this
written notice, the Mayor has called a special joint meeting of the Lomita City Council and Planning
Commission for the purpose of hosting a public workshop to discuss potential changes to the
Housing and Safety Element of the City’s General Plan.

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  JOINT CITY COUNCIL/PLANNING COMMISSION COMMUNITY WORKSHOP
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 30, 2021
  5:00 P.M.
  24300 NARBONNE AVENUE, LOMITA, CA, 90717

Pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-08-21, this meeting may be held via
teleconference. Members of the public are encouraged to participate via Zoom
URL: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83045390157 or by calling (669) 900 6833 Zoom
meeting ID: 830 4539 0157. For additional information on how to participate, please
contact the City Clerk’s Office at 310-325-7110 ext. 113.

HOUSING AND SAFETY ELEMENT PLANNING WORKSHOP TO PROVIDE INFORMATION
AND BACKGROUND ON THE PLANNED UPDATES TO THE HOUSING AND SAFETY
ELEMENTS OF THE CITY’S GENERAL PLAN

City staff will also solicit input and feedback from the community to help guide the process and
inform the substance of the updates.

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the
foregoing agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting at the following
locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and
uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to
participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at (310) 325-7110
(voice) or the California Relay Service.

Date Posted: June 24, 2021

________________________________
 Kathleen Horn Gregory, CMC, City Clerk

MINUTES OF THE
  JOINT SPECIAL MEETING
  LOMITA CITY COUNCIUPLANNING COMMISSION
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 30, 2021

  PURSUANT TO STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDER N.08.21, COUNCIL
  MEMBERS AND MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WERE ABLE TO PARTICIPATE VIA
  TELECONFERENCE. ACCESS TO THE MEETING WAS MADE AVAILABLE VIA ZOOM.

1  OPENING CEREMONIES

  a. Call Meeting to Order
  The special joint meeting of the Lomita City Council and Planning Commission was called
  to order by Mayor Waronek at 5:01 p.m. on Tuesday, June 30, 2021.

  b. Roll Call
  PRESENT: Council Members: U phoff, Waite (anived at 5:05 p.m.), Mayor Pro Tem Segawa,
  and Mayor Waronek (present in Council Chambers)

  Council Member Gazeley and Planning Commissioners Dever, Santos, Steinbach, Stephens,
  Thompson, Vice-Chair Graf, and Chair Cammarata (participated via Zoom)

  ABSENT: None

  STAFF PRESENT: C ity Manager Smoot, Community and Economic Development Director
  Kapovich, and Planner Repp-Loadsman (present in Council Chambers) Assistant City
  Manager Sugano, Management Analyst Hemandez, and City Clerk Gregory (participated via
  Zoom)

2. HOUSING AND SAFETY ELEMENT PLANNING WORKSHOP TO PROVIDE
  INFORMATION AND BACKGROUND ON THE PLANNED UPDATES TO THE HOUSING
  AND SAFETY ELEMENTS OF THE CITY'S GENERAL PLAN - City staff will also solicit input
  and feedback from the community to help guide the process and inform the substance of the
  updates.

  Consultants Elizabeth Dickson, Veronica Tam, and Asha Bleier, along with Management
  Analyst Hernandez and Planner Repp Loadsman, gave a PowerPoint presentation and
  responded to questions.

  No legislative action was taken at this meeting.
   Joint Meeting of the Lomita City Council/Planning Commission
  June 30, 2021

  3. ADJOURNMENT
  There being no further business to discuss, Mayor Waronek adjoumed the meeting at
  6:47 p.m.
